scripts.features:check: node -e "const r=require('./docs/features/registry.json'); const ids=r.features.map(f=>f.id); if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length) process.exit(1); if(r.features.some(f=>!/^FEATURE-\d{4}$/.test(f.id))) process.exit(1); console.log('Feature Registry válido:', ids.length, 'features')"
